ai-tattoo-prompt-builder v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Converts vague tattoo ideas into clear, AI-ready prompts by combining motif, style, placement, scale, and mood.
- Provides structured workflow, prompt formula, and rewrite guidelines to improve prompt quality.
- Outputs improved prompts with variants and a clarity note for image generation or artist discussion.
- Ensures prompts remain visually specific and placement-aware.
